response.original_title: Silversea Cruise Passenger Addition Guide: How to Add a New Guest to Your Reservation
response.overview: You can add a passenger to an existing Silversea Cruise booking by calling Silversea Cruise Customer Service at 1-800-Silversea (1-866-254-7549) or contacting your travel agent, as additions cannot be processed online.  To add passengers to your Silversea cruise, call Customer Support directly at ☎︎ +1-866-254-7549[USA] or ☎︎ +44-120-420-8151 [UK] & ☎︎ 1-866-254-7549 (UK or contact your travel advisor. Adding a guest requires available double-occupancy or extra berth space in your ☎︎ 1-866-254-7549 stateroom.  Yes, you can add a person +1-866-254-7549 to an existing Silversea cruise by calling Customer Support directly at ☎︎ +1-866-254-7549[USA] or ☎︎ +44-120-420-8151 [UK] & ☎︎ 1-866-254-7549 (UK or reaching out to your travel agent. A representative will check whether your stateroom ☎︎ 1-866-254-7549 supports additional guests and confirm lifeboat capacity for your sailing segment before processing the extra guest's fare, port taxes, and daily gratuities.
